speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for seeing me. To evaluate your sudden lower back pain radiating down your leg, please describe exactly where the pain starts and how far it travels. On a scale of 0 to 10, how severe is the pain, and does anything specific make it worse?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation. Based on your history of sudden onset pain during exercise radiating to the foot, this clinical picture strongly suggests a herniated disc compressing a nerve root. I will ask no further questions as the diagnosis is clear from your symptoms.
